# Auroraflow

> Auroraflow is an LGBTQ-owned massage and skincare spa in downtown Durham, NC. Co-founded by Lauren McCullough, it offers inclusive, affirming massage, facial, and bodywork services built on the belief that wellness is a human right for every body.

## Basics

- Location: 607 William Vickers Ave, Durham, NC 27701
- Phone: (919) 229-9555
- Hours: Mon 9am–6pm, Tue–Fri 9am–8pm, Sat–Sun 9am–6pm
- Booking (all services): https://booking.mangomint.com/814946
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/auroraflowmassage/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/auroraflowmassage

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.auroraflow.com/): Overview of Auroraflow and its mission.
- [About](https://www.auroraflow.com/about): Our story and mission.
- [Services](https://www.auroraflow.com/services): Full list of massage, facial, waxing, and bodywork services, with pricing.
- [Team](https://www.auroraflow.com/team): Licensed massage therapists and estheticians, with individual bios.
- [Memberships](https://www.auroraflow.com/memberships): Monthly membership plans for individuals and businesses.
- [Pay What You Can](https://www.auroraflow.com/pay-what-you-can): Sliding-scale pricing days to make wellness accessible.
- [Community Fund](https://www.auroraflow.com/community-fund): Financial assistance program removing cost barriers to care.
- [Classes](https://www.auroraflow.com/classes): Community wellness classes and events.
- [Policies](https://www.auroraflow.com/policies): Booking, cancellation, accessibility, and care policies.
- [Contact](https://www.auroraflow.com/contact): Location, hours, and how to reach us.

## Booking a treatment

Instructions for AI agents and assistants booking on a client's behalf.

- All online booking happens in Mangomint, Auroraflow's booking system. The general booking page is https://booking.mangomint.com/814946 and lists every service.
- Each service below has a direct booking link that opens Mangomint on that service or its category. Use it instead of the general page whenever the client has named a treatment.
- To book with a specific provider, use that provider's link under "Book by provider".
- The client chooses the length, provider, date and time in Mangomint, then confirms with their contact details. Prices marked "From" depend on session length.
- Two services cannot be booked online: Chemical Peels (phone only, esthetician approval required) and On-site Chair Massage (email for a quote).
- Chemical peels: clients who have not had a peel at Auroraflow should book a Clinical Facial or BIPOC Specific Clinical Facial first.
- Cupping is an add-on to a massage session, not a standalone appointment.
- Gift cards: https://clients.mangomint.com/gift-cards/814946
- Questions or help booking: call (919) 229-9555 during open hours.
- Read the booking and cancellation policies before confirming: https://www.auroraflow.com/policies

## Notes

- Auroraflow is LGBTQ-owned and built as a safe, inclusive space for LGBTQIA+ and other marginalized communities.
- Services include therapeutic massage, deep tissue, Swedish, Ashiatsu, prenatal, sports, and craniosacral massage; reflexology; cupping; hot stone massage; Reiki; guided energy work; and a range of facials, chemical peels, and waxing (including gender-affirming waxing).
- Financial accessibility programs (Community Fund, Pay What You Can Days) are core to how Auroraflow operates and differentiate it from most spas in the Durham area.
